canonical_role: sole top-level action router; v3 complete contracts with command/query boundary

patterns: verify whether this claim is supported
where else can work be found

state_discriminators.reason: existing comparable change result requested/available; read-side query wins over monitoring refresh
explicit refresh request; command-side monitoring wins

boundary_rules.rule: known-scope temporal refresh routes UC09; novelty beyond baseline routes UC10
broad paid-work discovery routes UC06; one declared metric routes UC08
simple platform mechanics routes UC05; contested/compound claim routes UC11
project-local method/policy change routes UC16; reusable system change routes UC19
repair inconsistency routes UC18; supported contract upgrade routes UC20
delivery feasibility routes UC12; acquisition feasibility routes UC13
source discovery routes UC04/UC10; source lifecycle management routes UC15
comparison routes UC14 only after needed dimensions are measured; otherwise UC08
perform/refresh/check known-scope research routes UC09; show/return an existing change result routes UC22
measure/recompute a metric routes UC08; show/aggregate an existing time series routes UC23
collect/triangulate evidence routes UC11; explain/interpret existing supported results routes UC24
audit the reusable system routes UC19; inspect freshness/coverage/comparability of research results routes UC25
UI surfaces compose query use cases and command actions; screen names do not create additional domain use cases
projection builders are capabilities owned by the result layer, not top-level use cases

use_cases.name: Start a new research project
use_cases.intent: Initialize a project when no reusable baseline exists.
not_when: A reusable prior project/archive is supplied → UC02.
use_cases.actor_intent: Initialize a project when no reusable baseline exists.

inputs.description: Initial decision question, scope and constraints; may start as template.

outputs.description: Initialized project structure with valid core state.

acceptance: Project core files exist and validate.
RUN_STATE has one explicit next action.

failure_modes.condition: Initialization cannot create/validate required project artifacts.

side_effects: Creates project directory and core state artifacts.

idempotency.strategy: Initialization is safe only for an empty/new target; never overwrite an existing project silently.

use_cases.name: Continue from previous research
use_cases.intent: Reconstruct prior research and continue without repeating valid work.
use_cases.actor_intent: Reconstruct prior research and continue without repeating valid work.

inputs.description: Prior project/archive/files supplied for continuation.

outputs.description: Validated reusable baseline with explicit next action.
Minimal reuse/refresh/continue/rediscover plan.

rules: Record baseline age/staleness rather than silently treating it as current.

acceptance: Baseline inventory is complete.
Pointers/state validate or repair is explicitly required.
Next action reuses valid prior work.

failure_modes.condition: No reusable baseline is present.
Baseline exists but state/pointers conflict.

side_effects: Creates continuation workspace and inventory.

idempotency.strategy: Repeated bootstrap must preserve the same baseline inventory and not duplicate history.

use_cases.name: Execute the next atomic task
use_cases.intent: Execute exactly one already selected Task Manifest.
not_when: No valid project/next task → UC01, UC02 or UC18.
use_cases.actor_intent: Execute exactly one already selected Task Manifest.

inputs.description: Exactly one concrete queued/in-progress task invocation.

outputs.description: Concrete task outputs plus acceptance statuses.

rules: Use the task-bound method/source versions; do not silently substitute newer contracts.

acceptance: Exactly one task is executed.
All required acceptance tests pass/not_applicable before status done.
Only manifest-allowed inputs/actions are used.

failure_modes.condition: Task precondition/capability/acceptance cannot be satisfied.
failure_modes.handling: Persist blocker and route to repair/next decision

side_effects: May write domain outputs declared by Task Manifest.
Updates task and run state.

idempotency.strategy: Task instance key + acceptance/output checks prevent duplicate logical execution.

use_cases.name: Discover candidate channels and sources
use_cases.intent: Discover candidate channels/sources without claiming effectiveness.
trigger_examples: where else can work be found
not_when: Known-scope refresh → UC09; novelty beyond baseline → UC10.
use_cases.actor_intent: Discover candidate channels/sources without claiming effectiveness.

inputs.description: Optional starting scope/routes for broad source/channel discovery.

outputs.description: Deduplicable candidate channels/sources with discovery provenance.

rules: Record discovery timestamp and route; discovery does not prove current effectiveness.

acceptance: Candidates retain discovered_via/route provenance.
No effectiveness/demand claim is inferred from mentions alone.

failure_modes.condition: Search completes without candidates.

side_effects: Appends candidates to SourceInbox.

idempotency.strategy: Deduplicate candidate identities/routes before promotion.

use_cases.name: Verify one channel/source/mechanism
use_cases.intent: Verify existence, mechanics, fees, eligibility or restrictions for one source/channel.
use_cases.actor_intent: Verify existence, mechanics, fees, eligibility or restrictions for one source/channel.

inputs.description: One source/channel/mechanism to verify.

outputs.description: Dated verified mechanics/fees/eligibility with limitations.

rules: Prefer current official/primary information for mutable mechanics.

acceptance: Mechanics are supported by appropriate evidence.
Verification date and limitations are explicit.
Practitioner experience is separated from platform mechanics.

failure_modes.condition: Verification depends on a contested/empirical claim.
Source metadata/lifecycle needs update.

side_effects: May update verified source metadata.

idempotency.strategy: Same source/mechanic/date can update verification record without duplicating source identity.

use_cases.name: Observe what paid work is being bought
use_cases.intent: Collect concrete paid tasks/deliverables from live or archived market evidence.
not_when: Metric measurement over a defined unit/window → UC08.
use_cases.actor_intent: Collect concrete paid tasks/deliverables from live or archived market evidence.

inputs.description: Paid-work scope, source route and sampling rule.

outputs.description: Concrete paid tasks/deliverables with stable source provenance.

rules: Collection window and sampling context are mandatory.

acceptance: Sampling rule is declared.
Concrete paid work is captured with stable source refs.
Discovery counts are not labeled demand frequency.

failure_modes.condition: Required source/capability cannot be accessed.

side_effects: Appends raw paid-work observations.

idempotency.strategy: Stable source/post identity plus semantic fingerprint prevents duplicate observations while preserving independent provenance.

use_cases.name: Normalize and clean observed work
use_cases.intent: Classify observations into service units/context and apply eligibility/deduplication.
use_cases.actor_intent: Classify observations into service units/context and apply eligibility/deduplication.

inputs.description: Eligible raw paid-work observations.

outputs.description: Deduplicated observations classified to service units/facets.

rules: Normalization uses the taxonomy/method version bound to the task.

acceptance: All included observations have eligibility decision.
Duplicates are resolved without dropping provenance.
Service unit and contextual facets are separated.

failure_modes.condition: Available observations are insufficient for the requested normalization scope.

side_effects: Creates normalized classification records.

idempotency.strategy: Same observation + taxonomy version yields stable normalized identity/classification unless method version changes.

use_cases.name: Measure one dimension
use_cases.intent: Measure exactly one declared market/economic dimension for a defined service unit and scope.
not_when: Broad task discovery → UC06; final comparison → UC14.
use_cases.actor_intent: Measure exactly one declared market/economic dimension for a defined service unit and scope.

inputs.description: One metric × service unit × market/source scope × window.
Comparable eligible observations for the metric.

outputs.description: One schema-valid metric result with method, coverage, missingness and limitations.

rules: Measurement freshness is defined by metric/window policy; stale inputs must be marked.

acceptance: Exactly one declared dimension is measured.
Method/version, window, eligible N, coverage and missingness are recorded.
Incompatible samples are not silently combined.

failure_modes.condition: Metric interpretation depends on unresolved evidence claim.
Requested decision still lacks another metric/dimension.

side_effects: Writes measurement/economics records.

idempotency.strategy: Measurement identity includes metric/scope/window/method version/source-route fingerprint.

use_cases.name: Monitor known scope over time
use_cases.intent: Recheck a known scope and build a conservative dated delta against a comparable prior run.
not_when: Search for genuinely new categories/sources beyond baseline → UC10.
use_cases.actor_intent: Recheck a known scope and build a conservative dated delta against a comparable prior run.

inputs.description: Known comparable scope/method/source routes to recheck.
Previous compatible run if available.

outputs.description: Comparable dated changes preserving new/changed/closed/reopened/not_seen distinctions.

rules: A new dated run is required for the monitoring date; partial/failed coverage is surfaced.

acceptance: DailyRun is finalized once.
Observations are append-only.
Diff uses only a compatible prior run.
not_seen is never converted to closed without explicit terminal evidence.

failure_modes.condition: Current method/source route is no longer comparable/usable.
Run/state/ledger inconsistency blocks safe comparison.

side_effects: Appends temporal observations/runs/diffs.
Updates current monitoring history.

idempotency.strategy: Observation idempotency keys and immutable run finalization prevent logical duplicates.

use_cases.name: Rediscover novelty beyond the baseline
use_cases.intent: Search deliberately for new channels, mechanisms, source families or work types not represented in the baseline.
trigger_examples: what new appeared in the ecosystem
use_cases.actor_intent: Search deliberately for new channels, mechanisms, source families or work types not represented in the baseline.

inputs.description: Known source/service/channel baseline used to define novelty.

outputs.description: Candidates not represented in the current baseline, with discovery provenance.

rules: Baseline version/date must be known so novelty is relative to an explicit baseline.

acceptance: Rediscovery searches beyond known routes.
Candidates are deduplicated against current registries/taxonomy.
Novelty is not confused with ordinary known-scope change.

failure_modes.condition: No novel candidates found under declared routes.

side_effects: Appends new candidate sources/work types to inbox.

idempotency.strategy: Baseline identity + discovery route + candidate identity suppresses duplicates.

use_cases.name: Triangulate one claim
use_cases.intent: Assess one formal claim using supporting, contradicting and independent evidence.
use_cases.actor_intent: Assess one formal claim using supporting, contradicting and independent evidence.

inputs.description: One scoped claim with population/time/geo semantics.

outputs.description: Evidence-linked claim status/confidence with counterevidence and limitations.

rules: Evidence temporal fit must match claim timeframe; mutable facts need current evidence.

acceptance: Claim scope is formalized.
Supporting/contradicting evidence and independence are explicit.
Counterevidence is preserved.

failure_modes.condition: Evidence remains insufficient/conflicted for requested claim status.

side_effects: Appends evidence and updates claim assessment history.

idempotency.strategy: Evidence items retain stable source identity; repeated evidence does not create false independence.

use_cases.name: Run a practical delivery test
use_cases.intent: Test what delivering one representative service actually requires in time, quality, setup and skill gaps.
use_cases.actor_intent: Test what delivering one representative service actually requires in time, quality, setup and skill gaps.

inputs.description: One representative service brief to execute/test.

outputs.description: Observed setup/execution/revision/communication effort and gaps.

acceptance: Representative brief is explicit.
Observed effort components are logged separately.
Delivery difficulty is not presented as market demand.

failure_modes.condition: Practical result exposes missing market/economic measurement.

side_effects: Writes practical-test/economics evidence.

idempotency.strategy: Test identity includes brief/version/setup; repeated trials remain distinct trials, not duplicate records.

use_cases.name: Run a market/acquisition test
use_cases.intent: Test a concrete acquisition route with declared exposure, cost and response outcomes.
use_cases.actor_intent: Test a concrete acquisition route with declared exposure, cost and response outcomes.

inputs.description: Offer/channel/exposure/period/cost definition for one controlled acquisition test.

outputs.description: Attempts, exposure, costs and response outcomes for the declared test.

rules: Test period is explicit; results are not generalized outside it.

acceptance: Exposure/attempt denominator is recorded.
Costs and responses are captured.
No global demand claim is inferred beyond the controlled test.

failure_modes.condition: Acquisition route cannot be executed under declared conditions.
failure_modes.handling: Persist blocker/coverage and route to repair if systemic

side_effects: Writes acquisition-test/economics evidence.

idempotency.strategy: Test ID + attempt ID prevent duplicate attempts while allowing repeated controlled tests.

use_cases.name: Filter, compare and update the decision
use_cases.intent: Compare candidates only on already measured dimensions and update keep/park/research-next decisions.
not_when: Missing measurements → UC08 rather than inventing an overall score.
use_cases.actor_intent: Compare candidates only on already measured dimensions and update keep/park/research-next decisions.

inputs.description: Measured dimensions/claims/economics needed for comparison.

outputs.description: Keep/park/research-next result without forced overall ranking.

rules: Decision may use only results whose freshness/status is explicit.

dimensions: method compatibility where metrics are compared

acceptance: Only measured/supported dimensions are compared.
Missing dimensions remain explicit.
No master score is invented unless separately specified and supported.

failure_modes.condition: Required comparison dimension is missing.
Delivery feasibility is unknown.
Acquisition feasibility is unknown.

side_effects: Writes decision and research-next state.

idempotency.strategy: Decision version references exact input result IDs so recomputation is traceable.

use_cases.name: Manage research sources
use_cases.intent: Add, deduplicate, review, reprioritize, retire or route reusable research sources.
use_cases.actor_intent: Add, deduplicate, review, reprioritize, retire or route reusable research sources.

inputs.description: New source candidate or lifecycle/priority/use-plan change.

outputs.description: Deduplicated source lifecycle/role/priority/use-plan update with provenance.

rules: Mutable source status/priority should reflect latest review; review history remains append-only.

acceptance: Source identity is deduplicated.
Role, category, status and priority remain distinct concepts.
Historical review/provenance is not rewritten.

failure_modes.condition: Source mechanics/eligibility are not verified.

side_effects: Updates source registry/use plan; appends review history.

idempotency.strategy: Canonical source ID prevents duplicate source promotion.

use_cases.name: Change a method or project policy safely
use_cases.intent: Change a versioned method or configurable project policy and propagate comparability/dependency effects.
not_when: Modify the reusable system architecture itself → UC19.
use_cases.actor_intent: Change a versioned method or configurable project policy and propagate comparability/dependency effects.

inputs.description: Versioned method or configurable project-policy change request.

outputs.description: Applied versioned change plus comparability/dependency impact set.

acceptance: Change is versioned.
Comparability impact is explicit.
Only affected downstream work is invalidated/reopened.

failure_modes.condition: Change requires schema/system migration rather than project-local update.
Change leaves project state inconsistent.

side_effects: Updates method/config and dependency invalidation state.

idempotency.strategy: Change ID/version prevents reapplying the same logical policy/method update.

use_cases.name: Checkpoint and hand off
use_cases.intent: Persist a consistent checkpoint so a clean chat/process can continue from explicit state.
use_cases.actor_intent: Persist a consistent checkpoint so a clean chat/process can continue from explicit state.

inputs.description: Validated project/run state to checkpoint.

outputs.description: Self-contained checkpoint/handoff with validated next action and manifest.

rules: Checkpoint must reflect current validated state at write time.

acceptance: Project validates before checkpoint.
Handoff carries next action.
Manifest is built last and verifies.

failure_modes.condition: Validation or manifest build fails.
failure_modes.handling: Do not claim checkpoint; route to repair

side_effects: Persists handoff/checkpoint and release-style project manifest.

idempotency.strategy: Repeated checkpoint at same logical state should be equivalent except timestamp/manifest metadata.

use_cases.name: Repair and reconcile a project
use_cases.intent: Reconcile state conflicts, incomplete transactions, broken pointers or inconsistent ledgers before research continues.
use_cases.actor_intent: Reconcile state conflicts, incomplete transactions, broken pointers or inconsistent ledgers before research continues.

inputs.description: Validation errors, broken pointers, transaction residue or conflicting state.

outputs.description: Conservative repair/reconciliation report and validated project state when recoverable.

acceptance: Repair never invents research facts.
Conflicts are reported rather than silently resolved.
Project validates before repaired outcome.

failure_modes.condition: Safe automatic reconciliation is impossible.
Problem is a version-contract mismatch.

side_effects: May remove/recover transaction residue or fix project pointers/state conservatively.

idempotency.strategy: Repair actions are conservative and repeated cleanup does not mutate valid research history.

use_cases.name: Audit or modify the reusable system
use_cases.intent: Audit the reusable system itself, change architecture, add a new use case, or handle unmatched/ambiguous top-level intent.
use_cases.actor_intent: Audit the reusable system itself, change architecture, add a new use case, or handle unmatched/ambiguous top-level intent.

inputs.description: Reusable-system audit/change/new-use-case request.

outputs.description: Audit evidence and/or versioned reusable-system changes with regressions.

acceptance: AX01–AX26 are evaluated for relevant changes.
Canonical contract is changed before derived views.
Release-gate defect fixes gain regression evidence.

failure_modes.condition: Audit finds unresolved defects.
No current use case fits the supported intent.
failure_modes.handling: Version and add a use case through governance

side_effects: May change reusable system architecture/version/tests/docs.

idempotency.strategy: System changes are versioned governance operations rather than replayed task mutations.

use_cases.name: Migrate a project to a newer system contract
use_cases.intent: Apply an explicit supported migration between system versions and validate the migrated project.
use_cases.actor_intent: Apply an explicit supported migration between system versions and validate the migrated project.

inputs.description: Project path plus source/target system versions.

outputs.description: Validated project under the target supported system contract with migration receipt.

acceptance: Migration path is explicitly supported.
Historical provenance is not fabricated/reinterpreted.
Target project validates before migrated outcome.

failure_modes.condition: No direct supported migration path exists.
failure_modes.handling: Stop and report required intermediate/bootstrap path

failure_modes.condition: Migration applies but project remains inconsistent.

side_effects: Versioned transformation of project contract/state; preserves historical data.

idempotency.strategy: Migration receipt/source-target versions prevent duplicate logical migration.

use_cases.name: Get Current State
use_cases.intent: Return the latest valid current research state for all research or one requested scope without performing new research.
not_when: Refresh/recheck sources now → UC09/UC08; discover novelty → UC10.
preconditions: Result Projection capability is available for execution; until Phase 3, routing/contract is implemented but product generation may return projection_unavailable.
use_cases.actor_intent: Return the latest valid current research state for all research or one requested scope without performing new research.

inputs.description: all or a concrete direction/service unit/channel/source.
Whether stale/invalidated results are excluded from the returned current view; default true.

outputs.description: Latest valid non-stale projection with included/excluded results, coverage, method/freshness/confidence context.

rules: Use latest valid results; stale/invalidated items are excluded by default and exclusion reasons remain visible.

acceptance: Returns exactly one CurrentStateSnapshot contract for requested scope when projection capability exists.
Does not collect, measure, refresh, or mutate research truth.
Stale/invalidated exclusions and coverage are explicit rather than silently hidden.

failure_modes.condition: Existing result inputs are missing, stale, partial, or insufficient for the requested view.
failure_modes.handling: Return an explicit research gap/refresh recommendation; do not silently invoke a command use case.

failure_modes.condition: The required projection builder/query capability is not implemented or available.
failure_modes.handling: Report capability unavailable and preserve the query intent; do not fabricate the product.

side_effects: Read-only query: must not mutate append-only research truth or silently perform external research.

idempotency.strategy: Against an unchanged canonical research snapshot, repeated query execution returns the same semantic product and performs no research mutation.

inputs.description: Scope whose changes should be returned.
Two dates/runs or from/to period identifying the comparison.

outputs.description: Comparable read-side change product preserving new/changed/confirmed_closed/reopened/not_seen/interesting semantics.

rules: Both endpoints must be identified; stale/partial coverage is reported in the ChangeSet.

not_when: Gather/triangulate new evidence → UC11; perform new measurement → UC08.
preconditions: Result Projection capability is available for execution; until Phase 3, routing/contract is implemented but product generation may return projection_unavailable.

use_case_groups.analysis: normalize, measure, test, reason and compare
use_case_groups.maintenance: monitor known scope and maintain reusable project resources/policies
use_case_groups.results: read-side result/query use cases returning typed research products without silently performing new research

interaction_types.query: returns a result without silently performing new research

execution_owners.research_agent: Research action is primarily executed by the research agent (currently ChatGPT); the application may ingest, validate, persist, derive from, or present its results without owning the research action itself.
execution_owners.application: The use case is primarily executed by the application as a product/runtime interaction.
execution_owners.mixed: Responsibility is intentionally split between research-agent semantic/research work and application deterministic, state, query, or presentation work.
execution_owners.internal: Internal runtime/maintenance behavior of the software system; not a primary research-agent action or end-user application feature.
execution_owners.development: Development/governance work on the reusable system itself; outside the runtime application feature set.
